title: Application Developer – Web, Android & iOS
description: Application Developer – Web, Android & iOS Company: Digilytics & Coding Company Job Type: Full-time Location: Hyderabad Experience: 3 years + About Us At Digilytics & Coding Company, we focus on building innovative, scalable, and high-performance digital solutions that solve real-world business challenges. We believe in engineering excellence, creative problem-solving, ownership, and continuous innovation. Our goal is to develop technology-driven solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences and measurable business impact. About the Role We are looking for a skilled and passionate Application Developer with hands-on experience in web and mobile application development, including Android and iOS platforms. The ideal candidate should be capable of developing applications from concept to deployment, integrating APIs, managing databases, and independently handling application publishing and maintenance on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. We value developers who take ownership, write quality code, and have practical experience delivering production-ready applications. Key Responsibilities Application Development •Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain web and mobile applications. •Build scalable, secure, responsive, and high-performance applications. •Develop native or cross-platform Android and iOS applications. •Translate business requirements and UI/UX designs into functional applications. •Develop and integrate REST APIs, databases, and third-party services. •Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code. •Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application bugs and performance issues. Google Play Store & Apple App Store Management •Prepare, build, and publish Android applications on the Google Play Store. •Prepare, build, and submit iOS applications to the Apple App Store. •Work with Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect. •Manage application signing, certificates, provisioning profiles, and release builds. •Handle application updates, version management, and production releases. •Understand Google Play and Apple App Store submission guidelines and compliance requirements. •Resolve application rejection issues and manage resubmissions. •Implement and manage push notifications, Firebase integrations, and app analytics as needed. •Monitor application performance, crashes, user feedback, and production issues. •Maintain existing published applications and release bug fixes and feature updates. Engineering & Collaboration •Collaborate with UI/UX designers, developers, and project stakeholders. •Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture planning. •Optimize application performance, security, scalability, and usability. •Follow software development best practices and version control workflows. •Stay updated with emerging technologies and mobile development trends. Required Technical Skills •Mobile Development: Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift, Java, or relevant native/cross-platform technologies. •Web Development: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, Angular, or similar frameworks. •Backend Development: Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, or similar technologies. •Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, or SQLite. •API Integration: REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations. •Android Publishing: Google Play Console, Android App Bundles (AAB), release signing, and publishing workflows. •iOS Publishing: App Store Connect, Xcode, TestFlight, provisioning profiles, and iOS release management. •Development Tools: Git, GitHub, Android Studio, VS Code, and Xcode. •Testing & Debugging: Application testing, troubleshooting, crash analysis, and performance optimization. Required Qualifications •Hands-on experience developing and deploying Android and iOS applications. •Proven experience publishing at least one mobile application to the Google Play Store or Apple App Store. •Strong understanding of the complete mobile application development lifecycle. •Experience integrating APIs, databases, authentication, and third-party services. •Ability to debug, optimize, and maintain production applications. •Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. •Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively. Preferred Qualifications •Experience publishing applications on both Google Play Store and Apple App Store. •Experience developing cross-platform applications using Flutter or React Native. •Knowledge of Firebase, push notifications, analytics, and crash reporting. •Experience with payment gateway integrations and user authentication. •Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated application deployment. •Experience managing live applications, production releases, and store compliance. •Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and AI-assisted development tools. What Makes You a Great Fit •You have independently developed and successfully launched mobile applications. •You understand both application development and production deployment. •You take ownership of projects from development to release. •You enjoy solving challenging technical problems. •You focus on performance, code quality, security, and user experience. •You are passionate about learning and adopting new technologies. Why Join Digilytics & Coding Company? •Opportunity to work on real-world web and mobile application projects. •Hands-on involvement in complete application development and deployment. •Exposure to modern development frameworks and technologies. •Collaborative and innovation-focused work environment. •Opportunities to develop technical expertise and take ownership of projects. Applicants are strongly encouraged to provide: •Links to Android applications published on the Google Play Store. •Links to iOS applications published on the Apple App Store. •GitHub profile or portfolio showcasing previous development work. •A brief description of their role in developing and publishing the applications. title: Full-Stack Python Developer (FastAPI + React + Automation) – GST SaaS Platform
description: Company: Nylun Global Private Limited Product: GST Software, a GST compliance and business software (SaaS) for businesses and CA firms Location: Hyderabad (work from office) Experience: 2–3 years Salary: ₹3,00,000 – ₹6,00,000 per annum (based on skills and experience) Employment type: Full-time, permanent About us Nylun Global Private Limited is building GST Software , a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India. Where we are today: the core modules are built as an advanced working prototype. We are now building the cloud SaaS platform : a modern React web app a FastAPI backend a PostgreSQL database a small, secure Windows agent that connects to the cloud and runs automated tasks on the customer’s own computer More products will follow, including audit and accounting software. This is the best stage to join: you will help build a SaaS product from the ground up and see it go live. Who we are looking for We want a young, energetic, hands-on developer who is: hungry for an opportunity to prove themselves on a real product, not just maintain old code ambitious to grow with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility passionate about technology, automation and AI , always learning new tools and better ways of working an owner , who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks a team player , happy to help and guide interns and freshers If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is seen, valued and rewarded, this role is for you. What you will do Build the SaaS backend in FastAPI: a modular monolith with clean REST APIs and OpenAPI documentation. Build the React frontend (Vite): fast, clean and easy-to-use screens, reports and dashboards. Design PostgreSQL databases: good data models, efficient queries and indexing for large data. Build a multi-tenant system: each customer’s data kept separate, with user roles and permissions, secure login and sessions. Background jobs with Redis: queues for long-running tasks such as imports, processing and report generation. File storage: store and serve documents and data files using S3-compatible object storage. Build the Windows agent: a Python tray application that connects securely to the cloud over WebSockets, receives jobs and sends back results. Browser automation with Selenium or Playwright: reliable automation of multi-step web workflows, with proper handling of sessions, timeouts, errors and retries always secure, and respecting each website’s rules Packaging and updates: build Windows installers for the agent and support automatic updates. Admin and internal tools: an operations admin panel for support, subscriptions and monitoring. Quality: automated tests (pytest), proper error handling, logging, code reviews, clean Git practice. Use AI every day: AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, to build faster, with the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code. Work with our Chartered Accountants to turn business requirements into accurate, working features. Help guide interns and freshers on daily tasks and code. Must-have skills 2–3 years of hands-on software development experience. Strong Python with FastAPI. Experience with Flask or Django also counts. React (with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS). PostgreSQL: good SQL, table design, joins, indexes. REST API design: authentication (JWT/sessions), validation, error handling. Browser automation: hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright. Git , and writing clean, readable code. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster. Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus. Strong plus Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar). WebSockets and async Python (asyncio). Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions. Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI). Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment to Linux, AWS, Azure or GCP. Automated testing with pytest. S3 or other object storage. Good to have GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience. Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth). Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools. Node.js or another backend language. No GST knowledge? No problem. Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn. What we are NOT looking for Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it. Someone who builds automation that works once and breaks often. Someone who wants to restart everything from scratch. We build carefully on the work already done. Why join Nylun Global Private Limited Build a SaaS product from the ground up and see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India. A real opportunity to prove yourself: your work directly shapes the product. Fast growth: a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform. Modern stack: FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, automation, cloud and AI tools. AI-first culture: work the way modern engineering teams work. Learning: learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants. Work directly with the founders , not through layers of management. Competitive salary: ₹3–6 lakh per annum based on skills and experience, with performance-based growth. Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
